blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis .
blocks.zh: 短波红外成像已作为一种有希望的自主驾驶方式出现,但其相对于红外光学的实际好处在各种条件下仍然表现不佳。 本文对RASMD数据集上的配对RGB和SWIR对象检测进行了系统比较研究,涵盖4个天气条件和2个实时检测架构,同时根据统一的地面真理进行了各种微调评价. 总体而言,在大多数情况下,RGB表现出可比或优异的性能,而RF-DETR则显示出不同条件下的更强健性. 除了综合度量表外,我们提议一个传感器主控采矿框架,该框架将多模式协议同有针对性的人工检查结合起来,以确定一种传感器模式利用基本上未经说明的对等数据提供更可靠的检测的情景。 这一分析显示,SWIR在四个安全危急的情况下提供了明显的优势,包括挡风玻璃、挡风玻璃上有水滴、低相撞物体能见度和远程车辆探测。 调查结果表明,应把《世界妇女状况报告》视为一种补充模式,在罕见但具有挑战性的条件下加强认识。 数据集将应要求提供,所有代码和训练有素的模型权重将在https://github.com/comse-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis上公开发布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Autonomous driving relies heavily on robust environmental perception for safe navigation in dynamic road conditions.
In current systems, this perception is predominantly achieved using visible-spectrum cameras, which suffer severe performance degradation in scenarios like low-light, fog, and adverse weather [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
To close this gap, integration of visible with Radar [ 5 ] , LiDAR [ 6 ] , Thermal (LWIR) [ 7 ] , NIR [ 8 ] , or deploying computationally heavy algorithmic enhancements like image dehazing have been tried [ 9 ] .
However, these are accompanied by high costs, resolution trade-offs, and often fail in adverse conditions.
Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) [ 10 ] , especially with the advent of CQD sensing technology [ 11 ] , is becoming increasingly accessible as a viable alternative, providing distinct advantages compared to traditional sensors.
blocks.zh:
自主驾驶在很大程度上依赖于强有力的环境观念,以便在有活力的道路条件下进行安全航行。
在当前系统中,这种感知主要是使用可见光相机实现的,在低光,雾等情景和恶劣天气[2,3,4]中,可见光相机的性能严重退化.
为了缩小这一差距,试验了将可见的雷达[5]、LiDAR[6]、热能(LWIR)[7]、国家清单报告[8]或部署像图像解压这样的计算重算法增强。
然而,与此同时,成本高,分辨率取舍,往往在不利条件下失败。
短波红外线(SWIR)[10],特别是随着CQD感知技术的出现[11],作为一种可行的替代方法,越来越容易获得,与传统传感器相比提供了独特的优势。

blocks.en:
Broader sensor surveys have positioned SWIR as a compelling candidate among emerging imaging modalities for autonomous vehicles.
Its unique spectral properties and complementary role alongside LiDAR, radar, LWIR, and NIR have been highlighted in [ 12 ] and [ 13 ] .
Empirical evidence indicates that SWIR maintains stronger robustness than visible-spectrum cameras under degraded visibility conditions such as fog, rain, and low illumination [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
In parallel, recent works have explored SWIR for detection and segmentation tasks.
For instance, the authors of [ 19 ] used cross-spectral mapping to generate SWIR training data to significantly improve deep-learning object detection models.
Additionally, in preliminary work [ 20 ] , we showed that SWIR imagery enables pre-trained models to outperform standard cameras for object detection and segmentation in dense fog, using a small dataset acquired in controlled weather conditions.
Highlighting its long-range capabilities, in [ 21 ] they show that SWIR wavelengths penetrate haze to provide clearer pedestrian detection at a distance.
blocks.zh:
更广泛的传感器调查将SWIR定位为自主车辆新兴成像模式中的一个令人信服的候选项目。
它独特的光谱特性和与LiDAR、雷达、LWIR和国家清单报告相辅相成的作用在[12]和[13]中得到了强调。
经验证据表明,在雾、雨和低发光等退化的能见度条件下,SWIR保持比可见光相机更强的稳健性[14、15、16、17、18]。
与此同时,最近的工作探索了SWIR的探测和分解任务.
例如,[19]的作者利用跨光谱绘图生成SWIR培训数据来大大改进深层学习对象检测模型.
此外,在初步工作[20]中,我们显示,SWIR图像使经过预先训练的模型能够使用在受控天气条件下获得的小型数据集,在密集雾中探测和分出物体时,能超过标准相机。
突出其长距离能力,在[21]中它们显示SWIR波长穿透出雾霾来提供更清晰的行人距离探测.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, existing studies largely focus only on a specific condition or all-combined evaluations, primarily due to limited data availability.
The introduction of the RASMD dataset [ 1 ] , the first large-scale paired RGB-SWIR set acquired in various weather conditions, as illustrated in Figure 1 , provided a benchmark across various tasks to analyze general SWIR capacities.
Subsequently, an empirical study leveraged this data to demonstrate SWIR’s optical advantages specifically under rainy conditions [ 22 ] .
Building on this, the availability of the dataset enables a more systematic investigation of cross-modal detection performance and motivates the need to identify exact cases where SWIR provides practical benefits over RGB.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有研究主要只侧重于特定条件或所有综合评价,主要原因是数据有限。
如图1所示,引进RASMD数据集[1],这是第一套在各种天气条件下获得的大型配对RGB-SWIR数据集,为分析一般SWIR能力提供了各种任务的基准.
随后,一项实证研究利用了这些数据,具体地证明SWIR在雨季的光学优势[22]。
在此基础上,数据集的可用性使得能够更系统地调查跨模式检测的性能,并促使人们有必要查明《世界投资报告》在哪些方面比《规则》提供实际好处。

blocks.en:
Contributions. This work makes the following contributions: (i) a comprehensive detection evaluation comparing paired RGB and SWIR images across four weather conditions, two real-time architectures, and five fine-tuning strategies against a unified ground truth; (ii) a sensor-dominance mining framework combining multi-model consensus with human curation to segregate, at scale, scenarios where a particular modality yields superior detections from unannotated paired data;
and (iii) identification and validation of four safety-critical SWIR-advantageous scenarios: glare, windshield water droplets, hidden objects under low-contrast, and distant vehicles.
blocks.zh:
捐款。 这项工作做出了以下贡献:(一) 一项综合检测评价,对四个天气条件下的配对RGB和SWIR图像、两个实时结构以及五个针对统一地面真理的微调战略进行比较;(二) 一个传感器主控采矿框架,将多模式共识同人类研究结合起来,以大规模地将某种特定方式从未经说明的配对数据中产生优异检测的情景分开;
(三) 确定和验证四起安全关键的SWIR型有利情况:光泽、挡风玻璃水滴、低相压下隐藏物体和远方车辆。

All code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis .

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en:
In this study, we evaluate different fine-tuning strategies for CNN- and Transformer-based object detection models on paired RGB and SWIR images captured under dynamic scenarios across four weather conditions.
An overview of the complete pipeline is shown in Figure 2 . This section outlines the dataset construction, fine-tuning strategies, and evaluation protocol used for model training and testing.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们评价在四个天气条件下在动态情景下捕获的配对RGB和SWIR图像上对基于CNN和变形器的物体探测模型的不同微调策略.
整个管道的概况见图2。 本节概述了用于模型培训和测试的数据集构建、微调战略和评价协议。

blocks.en: II-A Datasets
blocks.zh: II-A 数据集

blocks.en:
We utilized as base the aligned subset images from the RASMD dataset [ 1 ] , containing approximately 100,000 paired RGB-SWIR driving images divided into sunny, cloudy, rainy, and snowy conditions.
Although the original RASMD dataset provides an additional set of annotated images for the detection task, these are not utilized in our study due to certain limitations. In particular, the frequently lacking consistent spatial alignment and poor pairing of images between RGB and SWIR modalities can lead to object localization discrepancies. Moreover, the absence of explicit weather-wise division and limited scene diversity further limit its suitability for our evaluation.
A newer version of the detection subset (RASMD-detect-v2) addresses some of these issues; however, it was not available at the time of this study.
Therefore, we built our own detection datasets from the original version.
blocks.zh:
我们把RASMD数据集的对齐子集图像作为基础,其中包含大约10万对RGB-SWIR驱动图像,分为阳光,多云,多雨和多雪的条件.
尽管原始的RASMD数据集为检测任务提供了多一套附加注释的图像,但由于某些限制,这些图像在我们的研究中没有被使用. 特别是,RGB模式和SWIR模式之间经常缺乏一致的空间对接和图像配对,可能导致对象本地化差异. 此外,缺乏明确的天气区分和有限的场景多样性,进一步限制了其对我们评价的适宜性。
较新的检测子集(RASMD-detect-v2)解决了其中的一些问题;然而,在进行本研究时尚不具备.
因此,我们从原始版本建立了自己的检测数据集。

blocks.en: RASMD-IP. To evaluate general detection performance, we uniformly sample across all urban and suburban sequences in each weather condition , constructing a training set of 1,713 paired images, ensuring that the model is exposed to the full range of available scenes. This set is subsequently split into training and validation subsets. The test set, consisting of 800 paired images (i.e., 200 per weather condition), is sampled following the procedure described in subsection II-D , to ensure sufficient supports of each class for significant evaluation. Table I summarizes the class-wise distribution of samples in this dataset.

As detailed in subsection IV-B , a multi-model consensus framework followed by human curation is used to isolate 532 RGB–SWIR pairs exhibiting clear SWIR benefits. These samples fall into four recurring conditions: (1) windshield glare, (2) water droplets on the windshield, (3) low-contrast object visibility, and (4) distant vehicles. Each condition is further validated in subsection IV-C

blocks.en:
Annotations. Images from both datasets were manually annotated using a unified ground truth, where an object is labeled if it is visible in either the RGB or SWIR image. Note that in RASMD annotated set [ 1 ] , annotations are provided in modality-specific manner.
Additionally, the SWIR images were preprocessed by clipping intensity values at 99 % 99\% confidence interval to suppress outliers and stretching the histogram to enhance contrast [ 20 ] . Our annotated datasets will be made available upon request.
blocks.zh:
说明。 两个数据集的图像都是使用统一的地真来手动注释的,如果一个对象在RGB或SWIR图像中可见,则该对象会被贴上标签. 请注意,在RASMD注释集 [1]中,说明以特定方式提供。
此外,SWIR图像通过剪接强度值99%-99-%的置信间隔进行预处理,以压制出局并伸展直方图来增强对比[20]. 我们附加说明的数据集将应要求提供。

blocks.en: II-B Synthetic SWIR Generation
blocks.zh: II-B 合成 SWIR 生成

blocks.en:
In SWIR imaging research, the limited availability of labeled datasets poses a significant challenge, which has led to approaches for generating synthetic images from RGB data.
An other work [ 23 ] shows promising use of synthetic SWIR for fine-tuning detection models.
In this work, we also investigate the effectiveness of augmenting synthetic SWIR data alongside real SWIR data for fine-tuning detection models.
Building on the benchmarks established in [ 1 ] , we employ Pix2PixHD [ 24 ] to translate 20% of the RGB training images from the RASMD-IP dataset into the SWIR domain.
Combined with real SWIR images, we compare the resulting performance to models fine-tuned purely on real SWIR data (see Section III ).
blocks.zh:
在SWIR成像研究中,有标签的数据集的提供有限带来了重大挑战,这导致了从RGB数据生成合成图像的方法.
另一作 [23] 显示有希望地将合成SWIR用于微调检测模型.
在这项工作中,我们还调查了将合成的SWIR数据同真实的SWIR数据一起用于微调检测模型的有效性.
在[1]所建立的基准的基础上,我们利用Pix2PixHD[24]将RASMD-IP数据集的20%RGB训练图像翻译为SWIR域.
结合真实的SWIR图像,我们将所产生的性能与模型进行比较,纯粹根据真实的SWIR数据进行微调(见第三节.).

blocks.en: II-C Object detection Fine-Tuning Strategies
blocks.zh: II-C 物体探测

blocks.en: In this study, we explore two real-time deep learning object detection architectures: 1) YOLOv8x [ 25 ] , a CNN-based single-stage detector, and 2) RF-DETR [ 26 ] , built on a ViT backbone. Both models, pre-trained on the COCO dataset [ 27 ] , are fine-tuned on the following configurations of our RASMD-IP training data:
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们探索两个实时的深层学习对象检测架构: 1) YOLOv8x [25],一个基于CNN的单相探测器;2) RF-DETR [26],以ViT主干为主. 这两个模型在COCO数据集[27]上进行了预先培训,对我们RASMD-IP培训数据的以下配置进行了微调:

blocks.en: • RGB-only images , from all weather conditions, serving as the baseline aligned with the pre-training domain. • SWIR-only images , from all weather conditions, to evaluate standalone SWIR performance under domain shift. • Synthetic SWIR (20%), with real SWIR (80%) images , across all weather conditions, to explore the direction of expanding scene diversity in SWIR training using translated RGB data. • Mixed RGB-SWIR images , in equal proportion across all weather conditions, to study cross-modal learning within a single unified model. • Per-weather RGB / SWIR / Mixed images , where independent models are trained for each weather condition and modality. This is performed to examine condition-specific specialization versus generalization. In the rest of the paper, the data splits will be respectively referred to as RGB, SWIR, SWIR-Syn, Mix, and in the format [Weather]-[Modality] for weather-specific cases. The corresponding fine-tuned models use the following nomenclature [Model]-[Data] , for instance, YOLOv8x on mixed data is YOLO-Mix.

blocks.en: II-D Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 二-D 评价议定书

blocks.en: The overall dataset is inherently subject to high class imbalance, which further increases when split by weather conditions (e.g., presence of motorcyclists is rare compared to that of cars in rainy weather). To ensure sufficient class support for maintaining statistical significance across analyses, we use a rarity-weighted sampling strategy to construct the test set (800 images, 200 per weather condition). Pseudo-labels were generated for all the 100,000 images in a single modality using our YOLO-Mix fine-tunned model which was used to guide the selection. blocks.en: Metrics. For evaluation, we compute Weighted Precision ( Prec w ), Recall ( Rec w ), and F1-score ( F1 w ) deterministically on the RASMD-IP test images to account for the remaining class imbalance. Moreover, per-class average precision ( AP c ) and mean average precision ( mAP ), has been calculated in COCO style using stratified bootstrapping [ 28 , 29 ] with 1,000 iterations for stable analysis. Mean AP c is reported per class, while mAP is reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across weather conditions. All models are evaluated on their matching trained modality. Weather-specific models are evaluated on their matching weather subset only, while all-weather models are evaluated on both individual weather subsets and the combined test set. blocks.en: III-A Combined-Weather Analysis
blocks.zh: III-A 合并织物分析

blocks.en:
Table II presents the results of aggregated weather evaluation on RGB and SWIR images.
Overall, we observe that RF-DETR consistently outperforms YOLOv8 across both modalities and all fine-tuning strategies.
For RGB camera, the fine-tuning generally improves F1 w , Rec w , and mAP over the pre-trained weights for both models.
For SWIR, these gains from fine-tuning are more significant, due to the large domain gap between visible and SWIR imaging.
The Prec w remains competitive across all configurations in both models and modalities, indicating the gains are largely driven by a reduction in missed detections.
In all cases, Mix fine-tuning yields competitive performance compared to modality-specific fine-tuning, making it a viable single-model solution for use across both cameras.
Alongside, SWIR-Syn trained models yield comparable F1 w , Rec w , and mAP to SWIR-only models with only marginal drops, suggesting synthetic SWIR augmentation as a promising direction to address data scarcity, as also shown in [ 23 ] .
Notably, AP person drops after fine-tuning across all configurations and models, suggesting loss of generalization during domain adaptation, possibly due to low support combined with visual distinctiveness of pedestrian compared to other classes.
However, RGB camera results consistently give higher scores than their SWIR counterparts, indicating that the visible spectrum provides more favorable detection conditions when aggregated over all weather scenarios.

对于RGB相机,微调一般会改进F1 w,Rec w,和mAP,优于两种型号的预训练重量.
对于SWIR来说,由于可见和SWIR成像之间的大域差距,微调的这些收益更为显著.
Prec w在模型和模式上仍然在所有配置中具有竞争力,表明收益主要由错失检测的减少所驱动.
在所有情况下,Mix微调都会产生与模式特异性的微调相比的有竞争力的性能,使它成为跨两个相机使用的可行的单模型解决方案.
此外,SWIR-Syn训练有素的模型产生可比的F1 w,Rec w,和mAP到SWIR唯一的模型,只有边际下降,建议合成SWIR增强作为解决数据稀缺问题的一个有希望的方向,这也体现在[23].

然而,RGB相机结果的分数始终高于其SWIR对应的分数,表明可见光谱在所有天气情况汇总时提供更有利的检测条件.

blocks.en: Precision ( Figure 3a ) broadly remain competitive across all weather conditions (ranging between 0.73 to 0.93). A relative decline of scores is observed for snowy condition in both the cameras, which is due to complex scenes and reduced contrast during snow. YOLOv8 Weather-Specific Mix fine-tuning is observed to yield low precision with across all four conditions, occasionally accompanied by Weather-Specific Base, whereas RF-DETR maintains competitive scores under same configurations. This suggests YOLO is more susceptible to overfitting under limited per-condition training data. Off-the-shelf pre-trained again gives comparable precision scores to fine-tuned models.

yield scores comparable to the pretrained model. This is because the visible spectrum aligns closely with the pretraining domain under good visibility. Under cloudy conditions, RGB models significantly outperform their SWIR counterparts across same fine-tunings, potentially because of clear weather, accompanied by high visibility and strong contrast, whereas this gaps becomes thin for sunny condition due to uneven illumination. Under rainy and snowy conditions, the recall of both sensors remain competitive. Similar to combined evaluation, RF-DETR models are observed to marginally but consistently give better scores than YOLO under same fine-tuning, demonstrating superior choice. blocks.en: F-1 score ( Figure 3c ) and bootstrapped mAP mean ( Figure 3d ) broadly demonstrate similar trends, and hence are discussed jointly. Overall, training on domain-matched data (RGB trained models on RGB images and SWIR trained models on SWIR camera) gives the good results and maintains stability across most conditions. Weather-specific training again shows divergent behaviors; it results in sub-optimal performance for YOLOv8, whereas it demonstrate high performance fluctuations with RF-DETR across conditions and metrics. With that said, Mix fine-tuning remains consistently close to the top and even achieves the best mAP under snowy condition and SWIR camera using YOLOv8, making it a viable single-model option without significant loss in performance. For modality comparison, RGB again clearly dominates SWIR under cloudy conditions for similar configurations, with the gap progressively narrowing through sunny and rainy conditions. Both sensors become very competitive under snowy conditions, where a clear inference is not possible. This reinforce that harsh weather heavily degrades the visible spectrum. SWIR-Syn models perform at par with SWIR-only trained models across all weather conditions, further supporting synthetic augmentation as a future direction to handle SWIR data scarcity.
blocks.zh: F-1分(图3c)和被拖走的mAP平均值(图3d)大致显示了类似的趋势,因此将一并讨论。 总体而言,关于域域匹配数据的培训(RGB培训的RGB图像模型和SWIR培训的SWIR相机模型)提供了良好的结果,并在大多数条件下保持了稳定性. 针对天气的训练再次显示不同的行为;它使YOLOv8的性能低于最佳水平,而它显示不同条件和指标的RF-DETR性能波动很大。 如此一来,Mix微调仍然始终接近顶部,甚至实现了雪地状态下最好的mAP,而SWIR相机则使用YOLOv8,使得它成为一个可行的单一型号选项而不会在性能上出现重大损失. 就模式比较而言,在类似配置的多云条件下,RGB再次明显主导着SWIR,由于阳光和多雨的条件,差距正在逐渐缩小. 在雪地条件下,这两种传感器都变得非常有竞争力,在雪地条件下不可能有明确的推论. 这强化了恶劣的天气会严重地降低可见光谱。 SWIR-Syn模型在所有天气条件下都与SWIR唯一的训练有素模型相同,进一步支持合成增强作为未来处理SWIR数据稀缺问题的方向.

blocks.en: In summary, our combined and weather-wise analysis indicate that fine tuning generally improves detection performance for adverse weather, more significantly for the SWIR domain. All-weather domain-specific fine-tuned models show strong performance, and mix fine-tuning remains a competitive alternative. Conversely, weather-specific fine-tuning exhibits instability. RF-DETR proves more stable than YOLO and generally achieves higher evaluation metrics. However, across both types of anaysis, RGB camera metrics either matches or outperforms the SWIR camera metrics, asserting visible-spectrum imagery as primary and reliable modality for standard road-scene detection. This motivates a dedicated analysis to identify possible scenarios where SWIR camera provides us measurable benefits. The next section focuses on mining such scenarios using mininal human intervention.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的综合分析与天气分析表明,微调一般会改善不利天气的探测性能,对SWIR域来说更为显著. 全天候域特有微调模型显示性能强,混合微调仍然是有竞争力的可选方案. 相反,针对天气的微调显示出不稳定。 事实证明,RF-DETR比YOLO更稳定,并一般达到更高的评价指标. 然而,在两种麻醉剂中,RGB相机测量标准要么匹配要么优于SWIR相机测量标准,主张可见光成像是标准路面探测的主要和可靠的方式。 这促使我们进行专门分析,以确定SWIR相机向我们提供可衡量效益的可能情景。 下一节的重点是利用小型人类干预来开采此类情况。

blocks.en: IV Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Sensor-Dominance Mining
blocks.zh: 四. 综合计量之外:传感器 -- -- 治理 采矿

blocks.en: While the previous results establish the general superiority of RGB sensors over SWIR, some rare but safety-critical cases where the SWIR camera could provide us benefits may be masked in global performance averages. In this section, we investigate the complete base dataset to isolate those scenarios. We proposed a framework with three variants based on multi-model consensus to automatically segregate RGB-SWIR image pairs into one of RGB + (RGB detects objects absent in SWIR), SWIR + (SWIR detects objects absent in RGB), Equal (both modalities detect same objects), and Discarded (no decision can be made) categories. This significantly reduces the search space. Following human curation on the SWIR + set, we categorized the image pairs into four environmental scenarios based on common characteristics.
blocks.zh: 虽然以往的结果表明RGB传感器比SWIR普遍优越,但全球性能平均值可能掩盖了SWIR相机能够为我们带来益处的一些罕见但具有安全关键意义的案例。 在本节中,我们调查完整的基础数据集,以孤立这些情景。 我们提出了一个基于多模式共识的有三种变体的框架,将RGB-SWIR图像对自动分离成RGB +(RGB检测到SWIR中缺失的对象),SWIR +(SWIR检测到RGB中缺失的对象),等同(两种模式检测到相同的对象),并被丢弃(无法作出决定)等类别. 这大大缩短了搜索空间. 在SWIR + 集上进行人类解剖后,我们根据共同的特征将图像对分为四种环境情景。

Method M2 ( majority vote ) applies a majority-vote rule, requiring at least two consistent votes to establish a particular sensor-dominance; otherwise, pairs are categorized as Equal .
Method M3 ( unanimous vote ) enforces unanimous agreement, assigning sensor-dominance category only when all three groups agree, and categorizing all other cases as Equal .
Overall, M1, M2, and M3 define a spectrum from high recall to high precision, increasing confidence in sensor-dominant cases at the cost of a smaller sensor-dominant set, as low-confidence pairs are reassigned to Equal . blocks.en:
Across all three methods, the number of RGB + pairs are consistently more than SWIR + pairs, reinforcing the conclusions drawn from the global evaluation that visible-spectrum imaging remains dominant or equal in most scenarios.
At the same time, a limitation of the proposed framework is that no reliable decision can be made for 61.5% of the pairs due to simultaneous unmatched detections in both modalities or cross-group disagreement.
Nevertheless, the methods successfully isolate a measurable subset of SWIR + pairs, suggesting potential advantages for SWIR imaging in specific conditions.
Therefore, we introduce manual curation to filter out any spurious pairs categorized by algorithmic artifacts, and analyze the true SWIR + cases in greater detail.
blocks.zh:
在所有三种方法中,RGB+配对的数量始终大于SWIR+配对,这强化了从全球评价中得出的结论,即可见光谱成像在大多数情景中仍然占主导地位或相等.
同时,拟议框架的一个限制是,由于两种模式中同时检测到的不匹配或跨组分歧,无法对61.5%的对子做出可靠的决定.
尽管如此,这些方法成功地分离出SWIR+配对的可测量子集,表明SWIR成像在特定条件下的潜在优势.
因此,我们采用人工校正法来过滤任何被算法文物分类的假配对,并更详细地分析真实的SWIR+案例.

blocks.en: IV-B Manual Curation Procedure
blocks.zh: 四-B 人工校正程序

blocks.en: While the automated mining framework provides a useful first pass that identifies modality-dominance trends at scale, all three methods remain susceptible to incorrect modality-dominance assignments due to false positives, arising from model hallucinations and detection errors. To obtain a reliable subset, we focus our analysis on the SWIR + set and apply a manual curation procedure.
blocks.zh: 虽然自动化采矿框架提供了有用的第一通道,可确定规模上的模式主导趋势,但所有三种方法都仍然容易因模型幻觉和检测出错产生的假阳性结果而进行不正确的模式主导任务。 为了获得一个可靠的子集,我们把分析重点放在SWIR + 集上,并采用人工校正程序。

blocks.en: Each candidate pair is retained only if it satisfies two criteria. First, the SWIR advantage is verified through manual inspection, ensuring that it contains additional valid detections compared to RGB after removing false positives. Second, to avoid over-representation of near-identical frames from the same scenario, a minimum temporal spacing of 10 frames is enforced between consecutive filtered samples within each sequence.
blocks.zh: 只有在符合两个标准的情况下,才保留每对候选人。 首先,通过人工检查验证SWIR的优势,确保除去假阳性后,其包含与RGB相比的额外有效检测. 第二,为了避免从同一情况中过度表示近同帧,在每个序列中连续过滤的样本之间执行10帧的最低时间间隔。

blocks.en:
Following this process, we obtain a curated set of 532 distinct scene image pairs, that we named RASMD-HiLS (for Human in the Loop Segregation ).
Upon visual inspection, these samples exhibit four recurring environmental scenarios: (1) glare on the windshield, (2) water droplets on the windshield, (3) object hidden due to contrast, and (4) distant vehicles.
Finally, all selected frames are also manually annotated following a common ground truth for both modalities, as described in subsection II-A .
This results in a high-quality SWIR-beneficial dataset, which is used for subsequent analysis and validation.
blocks.zh:
在此过程之后,我们获得了一套由532个不同的场景相配的图案,我们命名为RASMD-HILS(对于环形隔离中的人类).
经目测检查,这些样品呈现出四种反复出现的环境情景:(1) 挡风玻璃上的玻璃;(2) 挡风玻璃上的水滴;(3) 因对比而隐藏的物品;和(4) 远方车辆。
最后,正如第二-A分节所描述的,所有选定的框架也都按照两种模式的共同基本真理进行人工说明。
这产生了高质量的SWIR-受益数据集,用于后续分析和验证.

blocks.en: IV-C Scenario-wise Analysis of SWIR-Advantage Cases
blocks.zh: IV-C 按情景分析SWIR-有利案例

blocks.en:
Following the construction of the curated SWIR-superior RASMD-HiLS dataset, the samples are grouped into the four identified environmental scenarios, and each of them is analyzed independently. Note that these scenarios are not mutually exclusive, and a single image may belong to multiple scenario buckets. To validate the reliability of these scenario-specific subsets, we employ RF-DETR-RGB and RF-DETR-SWIR on respective modality images, both of which were held-out in the filtering process. Table IV provides quantitative validation using weighted, binary, and class-wise metric of the same. For the class-wise AP c , only classes with significant supports have been taken into consideration. The results confirm that the mined dataset captures common scenario-dependent SWIR modality advantages. Figure 4 presents visual comparisons across the four scenarios.
We will now discuss each scenario in detail.
blocks.zh:
在构建了由SWIR-Superior RASMD-HILS数据集后,这些样本被归类为已确认的四种环境情景,并且分别进行独立分析. 注意这些情景并不相互排斥,一个单一的图像可能属于多个情景桶. 为了验证这些特定情景子集的可靠性,我们在相应的模式图像上采用了RF-DETR-RGB和RF-DETR-SWIR,这两种图像都是被屏蔽在过滤过程中. 表四采用加权、二进制和同级计量法提供定量验证。 对于类AP c ,只考虑有显著支持的类. 结果证实,所开采的数据集具有共同的基于情景的SWIR模式优势。 图4对四种情况进行了直观比较。
我们现在将详细讨论每一种情况。

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Glare on the windshield
blocks.zh: 挡风玻璃上的一面玻璃

blocks.en: This scenario corresponds to extreme visible-light saturation, typically caused by direct sunlight reflections when transitioning from low to high illumination conditions (e.g., just before exiting a tunnel). As shown visually in Figure 4a , such saturation significantly degrades RGB image quality, leading to missed detections, while SWIR remains largely unaffected. Quantitatively, Table IV validates this across all evaluation metrics in this setting, with substantial gains in recall(s) and AP(s). Notably, this scenario exhibits the largest performance gap between the two modalities.
blocks.zh: 这种情景对应极端可见光饱和,一般由从低发光条件向高发光条件过渡时(如刚出隧道前)由直接阳光反射而来. 如图4a所示,这种饱和度会显著地降低RGB图像质量,导致检测缺失,而SWIR则基本上未受影响. 从数量上讲,表四验证了这一背景下所有评价指标,在召回和AP(s)方面都取得了很大进展。 值得注意的是,这一设想表明两种模式之间的业绩差距最大。

blocks.en:
To further analyze this behavior beyond the curated dataset, we perform a temporal study on a sequence of approximately 200 frames of a vehicle entering and exiting a tunnel. We track detections counts of two leading vehicles over time across both sensors. Figure 5 illustrates the results for the four model groups (mixed and modality-specific versions of both RF-DETR and YOLOv8).
In all graphs, the modality advantage trend varies consistently across the tunnel transition, with RF-DETR-Mix exhibiting the most stable performance. During tunnel entry ( Figure 5a ), RGB briefly outperforms SWIR, as the scene transitions from high to low illumination and one of the vehicles lies in a darker region, where it remains distinguishable in RGB due to stronger appearance cues (color and texture), but is less discernible in the grayscale SWIR image. However, once the vehicle reaches near the other end of the tunnel, glare hits ( Figure 5b ), and RGB performance drops sharply due to saturation effects, whereas SWIR remains comparably stable. At the tunnel exit under normal illumination ( Figure 5c ), the performance of both modalities becomes comparable. The ground truth has again been marked using a unified human view across both modalities.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步分析这个超出所编译的数据集的行为,我们对大约200帧的车辆进出地道序列进行了时间研究. 我们追踪两辆主要车辆的探测数 穿越两个传感器 图5说明了四个模式组(RF-DETR和YOLOv8的混合版本和特定模式版本)的结果。
在所有图表中,方式优势趋势在整个隧道过渡过程中一直存在差异,RF-DETR-Mix表现出最稳定的性能. 在隧道入道(图5a)期间,RGB短暂地超越了SWIR,因为场景从高出光向低出光的过渡,其中一辆车位于更暗的区域,由于外观提示更强(颜色和纹理),在RGB中仍然可以区分,但在灰度的SWIR图像中不太明显. 然而,一旦车辆到达地道另一端附近,闪光相撞(图5b),而RGB性能由于饱和效应而急剧下降,而SWIR则保持相仿的稳定. 在正常照明下的地道出口(图5c),两种模式的性能都具有可比性. 地面真相再次在两种模式中采用统一的人类观点来标示。

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Water on the windshield
blocks.zh: 四-C 2 挡风玻璃上的水

blocks.en: This scenario encompasses adverse conditions such as rain or snow, where water droplets accumulate on the windshield, introducing scattering, refraction, and localized blur that significantly degrade visibility in the RGB domain. As illustrated in Figure 4b , this often leads to missed detections. In contrast, SWIR is less affected by droplet-induced scattering and can better penetrate such obstructions, preserving scene structure and enabling more reliable detections, consistent with findings in [ 22 ] . This behavior is further validated in Table IV , where this scenario exhibits the second-largest performance gap after glare, with notable improvements in recall(s) and AP(s) for SWIR.
blocks.zh: 这种情景包括了雨或雪等不利条件,即水滴会积聚在挡风玻璃上,引入散射,折射,以及局部模糊等显著地降低RGB域能见度. 如图4b所示,这往往导致检测缺失。 相形之下,SWIR受到由液滴引起的散射的影响较小,可以更好地穿透这些障碍物,保持场景结构并能够进行更可靠的探测,这与[22]中的调查结果一致. 这种行为在表四中得到了进一步验证,其中这一情景显示了光芒后第二大性能差距,SWIR的召回和AP(s)都有了显著的改善.

blocks.en: IV-C 3 Object hidden due to contrast
blocks.zh: 四-C 3 对象因对比而隐藏

blocks.en: Unlike visibility degradation caused purely by environmental obstructions, this scenario arises from intrinsic scene properties where objects have low contrast against their background. In such cases, similar color distributions, shadows, or weak texture in RGB cause objects to blend into the scene, leading to missed detections, as demostrated for a motorcyclist in Figure 4c . SWIR, on the other hand, leverages material reflectance differences, which improves the foreground–background separation making such low contrast objects easier to detect. Quantitatively, both modalities show comparable precision, while SWIR reduces missed detections. The improvement is particularly significant for the person class, highlighting pedestrians are impacted by such low-contrast conditions.
blocks.zh: 与纯粹由环境障碍造成的能见度退化不同,这种情景来自物体与其背景对比不大的内在场景特性。 在这种情况下,类似的颜色分布,阴影,或RGB中的弱纹理会使物体被混入到场景中,导致被错失了检测,如图4c中为摩托车手所分解. 另一方面,SWIR利用物质反射差异,这改善了前地-后地分离,使得这种低对比物体更容易被检测出. 从数量上看,两种模式都表现出相近的精确度,而SWIR则会减少被错失的检测. 这种改善对人文阶层尤其重要,突出显示行人受到这种低相干条件的影响。

blocks.en: IV-C 4 Vehicle at a distance
blocks.zh: 四-C 4 相距车辆

blocks.en: This scenario captures long-range detection, where small object size and atmospheric effects such as haze reduce visibility in RGB. While RGB can sometimes also retain advantages due to color and appearance properties, its performance degrades more rapidly under such conditions. As shown in Figure 4d , SWIR being less sensitive to visible-spectrum scattering and color attenuation, provides more stable signal characteristics at longer ranges, enabling improved detection of distant vehicles. This is further supported by Table IV , where SWIR demonstrates improved detection performance under degraded visibility, although it may not be universally superior in all long-range scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这种情景捕捉出长距离探测,其中小物体大小和雾霾等大气效应会降低RGB的能见度. 虽然RGB有时也可以由于颜色和外观特性而保留优势,但其性能在这种条件下降解得更快. 如图4d所显示的,SWIR对可见光谱散射和色衰减的敏感度较低,在更远的范围内提供了更稳定的信号特性,从而能够改进对远方车辆的探测。 这一点还得到表四的进一步支持,在该表中,SWIR显示在能见度下降的情况下探测性能有所改善,尽管它可能并非在所有远程情景中普遍优越。

blocks.en: Overall, while less frequent in real-world driving scenarios, these four scenarios are safety-critical, and SWIR offers a meaningful detection advantage precisely where RGB fails.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,虽然在现实世界的驱动情景中频率较低,但这四种情景对安全至关重要,而SWIR恰恰在RGB故障时提供了有意义的检测优势.

blocks.en: V Discussions and Limitations of the study
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论和研究的局限性

blocks.en:
Comparison of detection performances. Across all fine-tuning strategies and weather conditions ( Table II , Figure 3 ), RGB generally matches or outperforms SWIR, likely due to richer appearance cues and higher channel diversity.
In contrast, SWIR benefits more strongly from fine-tuning, reflecting a larger domain gap from visible-domain pretraining.
Architecturally, the transformer-based RF-DETR consistently outperforms the CNN-based YOLOv8 across modalities, weather conditions, and training strategies, establishing it as the more robust framework.
Mixed fine-tuning with equal proportions of RGB and SWIR emerges as an effective single-model solution, encouraging modality-invariant representations and achieving competitive cross-modal performance, a trend further confirmed by the temporal tunnel evaluation ( Figure 5 ).
Synthetic SWIR augmentation also proves promising in alleviating data scarcity, whereas weather-specific fine-tuning, particularly for YOLOv8, produces inconsistent results, likely due to overfitting and limited generalization.
blocks.zh:
检测性能比较. 在所有微调战略和天气条件(表二,图3)中,RGB一般匹配或优于SWIR,这可能是由于外观提示更丰富和信道多样性更高.
相形之下,SWIR更能从微调中得益,反映了可见域预训带来的较大域间隙.
从结构上看,基于变压器的RF-DETR在模式、天气条件和培训战略上一直超越基于CNN的YOLOv8,将其确立为更强有力的框架。
与RGB和SWIR比例相等的混合微调,作为一种有效的单一模式解决方案出现,鼓励模式变化的表述并实现竞争性的跨模式性能,这一趋势得到时间隧道评价的进一步证实(图5)。
合成 特别针对YOLOv8天气的微调可能产生不一致的结果,可能是由于过于适应和通用性有限。

blocks.en:
Identification of SWIR-advantage cases. Although 61.5% of pairs are labeled as Discarded , the sensor-dominance mining framework ( subsection IV-A ) successfully isolates SWIR-advantageous cases across its three variants ( Equation 3 ), offering a trade-off between selection accuracy and review effort.
Manual inspection reveals four recurrent scenarios ( Figure 4 ) where SWIR improves recall while maintaining comparable precision.
The most pronounced gains occur under glare, windshield water droplets, low-contrast pedestrian scenes, and long-range vehicle detection, where RGB performance degrades due to saturation, scattering, low visual contrast, or atmospheric effects, while SWIR remains comparatively robust.
blocks.zh:
查明SWIR-有利案例。 虽然61.5%的对子被贴上被丢弃的标签,但传感器主控采矿框架(分节IV-A)成功地将SWIR-优势案例分离出其三个变体(第3个方程式),在选择的准确性和审查努力之间提供了取舍。
人工检查揭示了四种经常出现的情况(图4),即SWIR改进了召回,同时保持了可比较的精确性。
最显著的增益出现在闪光,挡风玻璃水滴,低相混接行人场景和长距离车辆探测等下,其中RGB性能因饱和,散射,低视觉对比而退化,或大气效应,而SWIR仍然相对坚固.

blocks.en: Limitations. This study has several limitations that should be considered when interpreting the results. First, the dataset which reflects real-world driving conditions exhibits strong class imbalance. This, combined with the presence of sequential frames, makes it challenging to ensure sufficient scene diversity and class representation during training, and can lead to overfitting for some underrepresented classes (e.g., AP person in Table II ). Second, the proposed sensor-dominance mining framework operates without ground truth and relies on multi model agreement, which may introduce bias toward model-specific behaviors. As a result, a significant portion of data is discarded during filtering, potentially overlooking scenarios even rare in number where SWIR could provide additional benefits. Finally, the mined SWIR + subsets inherit the class distribution of the underlying dataset, where certain conditions (e.g., glare) are dominated by only certain classes (e.g., cars). This necessitates us to use weighted or binary metrics and validating only the statistically significant classes.
blocks.zh: 限制。 这项研究有一些局限性,在解释研究结果时应予考虑。 首先,反映现实世界驱动条件的数据集显示出强烈的阶级不平衡。 这再加上存在相继的框架,使得在培训期间确保足够的场景多样性和班级代表性具有挑战性,并可能导致一些代表性不足的班级(例如表二中的AP人)的偏差. 其次,拟议中的传感器支配采矿框架没有地面真实性,而依赖于多种模式协议,这可能会对模式特定行为产生偏见。 因此,在过滤过程中,大量数据被丢弃,有可能被忽略的情景甚至很少见,因为SWIR可以提供额外的好处。 最后,被布雷的SWIR+子集继承了基础数据集的类分布,其中某些条件(如:glare)仅由某些类别(如:汽车)所支配. 这就要求我们使用加权或二进制衡量标准,并只验证具有统计意义的类别。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
The results of this study provide a comprehensive evaluation of RGB and SWIR sensing modalities for object detection under real-world driving conditions, and surface several findings for practical implications of both sensors.
While aggregate performance indicates the dominance of RGB as the primary modality for general road-scene detection, such global metrics fail to capture rare but safety-critical conditions where SWIR could be useful.
Based on speed, accuracy, and resources, RF-DETR with mixed fine-tuning emerges as a well-balanced cross modal choice.
The proposed sensor-dominance mining framework, combining multi-model consensus with targeted manual curation, serves as a scalable approach to segregate modality-specific advantageous pairs from large paired unannotated datasets, and its effectiveness can be further extended with the availability of higher-quality training data and more advanced detection models.
Within the scope of this study, the framework isolates four SWIR-advantageous conditions: windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, object visibility under low contrast, and distant vehicle perception, each of which is further validated through quantitative analysis.
Among these, glare represents the most severe failure of RGB while low-contrast conditions majorly impact pedestrian detection, making SWIR particularly valuable for vulnerable road user safety.
blocks.zh:
这项研究的结果对在现实世界驱动条件下探测物体的RGB和SWIR的感应方式进行了全面的评价,并对这两种传感器的实际影响提出了几项结论。
虽然总体性能表明RGB作为一般路面探测的主要方式占主导地位,但这种全球度量标准未能捕捉到在SWIR可能有用的罕见但安全的关键条件。
基于速度、准确性和资源,采用混合微调的RF-DETR作为一种平衡的跨模式选择出现。
拟议的传感器主控开采框架将多模式共识与定向人工校准相结合,成为将模式特定优势对子与大型对子无附加说明数据集相分离的可扩展方法,其有效性可以随着更高质量的培训数据和更先进的检测模型的提供而进一步扩大.
在本研究范围内,框架隔离出四个SWIR-优异的条件:挡风玻璃,挡风玻璃上有水滴,低对比下物体能见度,和远行车辆感知,每个条件通过定量分析进一步验证.
其中,闪光是RGB最严重的失败,而低相干条件主要影响行人探测,使SWIR对脆弱的道路使用者安全特别有价值.

blocks.en: These strengths motivate future work on adaptive fusion strategies that dynamically leverage SWIR under challenging environmental conditions [ 30 ] . Improving synthetic-to-real alignment for SWIR image generation also remains an open challenge, with future directions including the development of SWIR-specific generative models and broader validation across more diverse datasets and sensor configurations.
blocks.zh: 这些优势激励着今后关于适应性聚变战略的工作,这些战略在具有挑战性的环境条件下能够动态地利用空间环评机制[30]。 改进SWIR图像生成的合成-实际对接也仍然是一项公开的挑战,未来的方向包括开发SWIR特有的基因模型并更广泛地验证更多样化的数据集和传感器配置。
